sentences.text: Drax the Destroyer -LRB- Arthur Douglas -RRB- is a fictional character appearing in American comic books published by Marvel Comics .	Marvel Comics	Marvel Comics	fictional character	fictional character
Created by writer/artist Jim Starlin , the character first appeared in Iron Man # 55 -LRB- February 1973 -RRB- .	Iron Man	Iron Man	1973	1973 in comics	Jim Starlin	Jim Starlin
Arthur Douglas was a human whose family was attacked and killed by the supervillain Thanos .	Thanos	Thanos	supervillain	supervillain
Needing a champion to combat Thanos , the being known as Kronos took Arthur 's spirit and placed it in a powerful new body , and Drax the Destroyer was born .	Thanos	Thanos	Kronos	Kronos (comics)
Drax 's powers included enhanced strength and resilience , flight , and the ability to project energy blasts from his hands .
The character often battled Thanos , and on occasion the superheroes Captain Marvel and Adam Warlock .	Thanos	Thanos	Captain Marvel	Captain Marvel (Mar-Vell)	Adam Warlock	Adam Warlock
He was also a member of the group known as the Infinity Watch .	Infinity Watch	Infinity Watch
In 2004 , the character lost his flight and energy blasts , and a portion of his strength and resilience .

This version of the character played a role in the crossover comic book storylines `` Annihilation '' and `` Annihilation : Conquest '' , and became a member of the relaunched Guardians of the Galaxy .	Guardians of the Galaxy	Guardians of the Galaxy (film)	crossover	fictional crossover	Annihilation	Annihilation (comics)
He has been featured in a variety of associated Marvel merchandise , including animated television series , action figures , and video games .	animated	animation	television series	television series

Drax is portrayed by Dave Bautista in the 2014 live-action film Guardians of the Galaxy , its 2017 sequel , and the upcoming Avengers : Infinity War .	Guardians of the Galaxy	Guardians of the Galaxy (film)	Dave Bautista	Dave Bautista	2017 sequel	Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
